home.title: Servy - Enterprise-Grade Windows Service Wrapper
home.description: Servy is a Windows service wrapper that lets you run any app as a native Windows service with real-time monitoring, auto-recovery, logging, and health checks.
home.ogDescription: Servy lets you run any app as a native Windows service with full control over working directory, startup type, process priority, logging, health checks, environment variables, dependencies, pre-launch and post-launch hooks, and parameters.
home.hero.title: Enterprise-Grade Windows Service Wrapper
home.hero.bullet1: Run Any Application as a Native Windows Service
home.hero.bullet2: Manage with Desktop UI, CLI, or PowerShell
home.hero.bullet3: Per-Service Isolation and Automated ACL Hardening
home.hero.bullet4: Sensitive Data Protected by Authenticated Encryption
home.hero.bullet5: Monitor CPU/RAM and Console Output with Automatic Recovery
home.hero.secBullet1: Digitally Signed and Verified by Microsoft Security Intelligence
home.hero.secBullet2: Available on WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop, and Patch My PC
home.features.heading: Why use Servy?
home.features.universal.title: Universal Access
home.features.universal.desc: Install and manage services from the desktop app, CLI, PowerShell, or embedded installers.
home.features.recovery.title: Auto-Recovery
home.features.recovery.desc: Automatically restart services after crashes, hangs, or unexpected exits, or execute custom failure programs.
home.features.process.title: Full Process Control
home.features.process.desc: Set command-line arguments, working directory, process priority, CPU affinity, and environment variables.
home.features.security.title: Enterprise Security
home.features.security.desc: Per-service isolation with least privilege. Run as gMSA, Active Directory, or Local System accounts.
home.features.hooks.title: Lifecycle Hooks
home.features.hooks.desc: Run commands before and after launch or stop, with built-in logging and timeouts.
home.features.monitoring.title: Live Monitoring & Logging
home.features.monitoring.desc: Track CPU and RAM usage, stream stdout/stderr in real time, and configure size-based or date-based log rotation.
home.features.shutdown.title: Graceful Shutdown
home.features.shutdown.desc: Stops processes cleanly with a graceful shutdown or Ctrl+C, then force-kills the whole process tree if needed.
home.features.health.title: Health Checks
home.features.health.desc: Detect failures automatically and get instant alerts via email, WhatsApp, webhooks, or OS notifications.
home.features.dependencies.title: Visual Dependencies
home.features.dependencies.desc: Visualize service dependencies and export configurations for repeatable deployments.
home.getStarted.heading: Get Started
home.getStarted.intro: Download the latest release from GitHub or install via a package manager:
home.getStarted.patchMyPc: Servy is available in the official Patch My PC catalog for enterprise automated deployment and updates via Microsoft Intune and ConfigMgr.
home.example.heading: Quick Example
home.example.intro: You can manage services using the desktop app, CLI, or PowerShell.
home.example.outro: This installs NodeApp to run a Node.js server in the background with auto-startup. See additional examples and recipes for Python, Java, Go, and other runtimes.
home.useCases.heading: Use Cases
home.useCases.web.title: Web Servers & APIs
home.useCases.web.desc: Run Node.js, Python, Go, or Java servers that start with Windows and restart after failures.
home.useCases.ai.title: AI Models & LLMs
home.useCases.ai.desc: Host local LLMs and AI APIs such as Ollama or Stable Diffusion as always-on services.
home.useCases.workers.title: Background Workers
home.useCases.workers.desc: Keep message queue consumers (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and long-running workers alive in the background.
home.useCases.cicd.title: CI/CD & DevOps
home.useCases.cicd.desc: Keep self-hosted build agents (GitHub Actions, GitLab Runners, Jenkins) online.
home.useCases.automation.title: Automation & Scripts
home.useCases.automation.desc: Run PowerShell or Python scripts as persistent daemons for file cleanup, backups, or system monitoring.
home.useCases.proxies.title: Database Proxies
home.useCases.proxies.desc: Run database tunnels and proxies (Cloud SQL Auth Proxy, Ngrok) as services for stable connectivity.
home.useCases.remote.title: Remote Management Agents
home.useCases.remote.desc: Run monitoring agents and remote tools as background services for uninterrupted access.
home.useCases.network.title: Network Utilities & Proxies
home.useCases.network.desc: Run DNS servers, reverse proxies (Caddy, Nginx), or VPN clients in the background for reliable networking.
home.useCases.legacy.title: Legacy App Modernization
home.useCases.legacy.desc: Wrap tools that were never built as services, and give them lifecycle management and health monitoring.
home.support.heading: Support
home.support.desc: Servy is free and open source. If it helped you, saved you time, or powered your production workflows, consider supporting the project to keep it active, independent, and free for everyone.
home.ack.heading: Acknowledgments
home.ack.desc: Thanks to SignPath and the SignPath Foundation for providing free code signing, to Christophe Rogiers for his valuable contributions, and to everyone who tested Servy, reported issues, or suggested improvements on GitHub and Reddit.
